name: FrankX Social Tool Intelligence 2026
governing_thesis: Founders should choose a social platform by operating role, control boundary, and evidence—not by feature count, brand temperature, or affiliate commission.
editorial_constraint: Every canonical must own a distinct reader job, expose official sources, state its evidence class, answer the decision directly, and preserve the documentation-versus-pilot boundary.
commercial_constraint: Program availability is recorded only after editorial fit; a tracked link requires verified enrollment and adjacent disclosure, and commission can never alter role score or architecture.

request_manifest.requested_label: Living social media tool resource hub
request_manifest.resolution: Owns current registry, role routing, evidence links, comparison interaction, architecture, and commercial-status disclosure.

request_manifest.requested_label: Ultimate founder social media management tool guide
request_manifest.resolution: Owns the broad high-intent search decision and category-correct operating model.
Owns the one-brand versus analytics-and-MCP comparison intent.
Will own analytics-cockpit versus simple-channel-priced scheduler intent after proof-wave evidence.
Will own open-control versus AI-content-automation intent without pretending the products are identical.

request_manifest.requested_label: Best social media APIs for agents and developers
request_manifest.resolution: Will own API-first product and agent infrastructure intent across Ayrshare, Upload-Post, Postiz, Mixpost, Buffer, and Typefully.

request_manifest.requested_label: Sprout Social versus Hootsuite versus HubSpot
request_manifest.resolution: Will own governance-suite versus CRM-system intent for enterprise readers.
Will own implementation intent for source memory, approvals, API or MCP execution, receipts, and learning.

canonicals.reader_job: Inspect and compare the current social tool field by operating role with primary evidence in one living surface
canonicals.thesis: A governed registry and role router is more useful than a static universal leaderboard.
canonicals.unique_artifact: Interactive fifteen-tool Decision Atlas backed by one typed source, claim, price, capability, and commercial-status registry
canonicals.commercial_role: Neutral comparison and evidence destination; official product links only at launch

canonicals.reader_job: Choose the best social media management category and product for the reader's current operating role
canonicals.thesis: The best tool is the smallest control plane that fits the role, preserves judgment, and produces learning.
canonicals.unique_artifact: Fifteen-tool field guide, category map, normalized cost model, agent control plane, and thirty-day adoption proof
canonicals.commercial_role: Broad high-intent discovery that routes to the neutral atlas and official evidence

canonicals.reader_job: Decide whether Pallyy or Metricool fits the next thirty days
canonicals.thesis: Pallyy is the one-brand default; Metricool earns its wider surface through analytics, brand count, reporting, or MCP use.
canonicals.unique_artifact: Current plan tables, API-versus-MCP boundary, scenario verdict, decision tree, and thirty-day pilot
canonicals.commercial_role: Specific comparison intent with official direct links and explicit no-relationship disclosure

canonicals.reader_job: Choose between an analytics-led brand cockpit and a simpler channel-priced scheduler
canonicals.thesis: Metricool wins when measurement and multiple brands are the job; Buffer wins when familiarity and a small channel set reduce friction.
canonicals.unique_artifact: Normalized brand-versus-channel price model and report-usage decision test
canonicals.commercial_role: Future comparison route subject to proof-wave engagement and source refresh

canonicals.reader_job: Choose between open publishing control and an integrated AI content-distribution workflow
canonicals.thesis: Postiz and Blotato are adjacent control-plane choices, not interchangeable schedulers.
canonicals.unique_artifact: Control-versus-generation topology, credit and operations cost model, and automation failure test
canonicals.commercial_role: Future comparison route subject to first-wave evidence

canonicals.reader_job: Select a social API boundary for a product, automation, or governed agent system
canonicals.thesis: An API provider should execute approved side effects while the product retains memory, policy, idempotency, receipts, and recovery.
canonicals.unique_artifact: Endpoint and control-boundary matrix across managed, self-hosted, and white-label routes
canonicals.commercial_role: Developer-intent canonical with architecture-first vendor routing

canonicals.reader_job: Choose an enterprise social suite by governance, service, listening, and CRM boundary
canonicals.thesis: Sprout and Hootsuite are dedicated social suites; HubSpot wins only when the CRM and revenue record are the governing system.
canonicals.unique_artifact: Governance, service, attribution, permission, and total-seat-cost evaluation model
canonicals.commercial_role: Enterprise decision route requiring deeper workflow evidence

canonicals.reader_job: Implement a safe multi-agent social publishing and learning loop
canonicals.thesis: Human authority, source truth, execution adapters, receipts, and outcome learning must remain explicit and replaceable.
canonicals.unique_artifact: Reference contracts for brand memory, approval payloads, API or MCP adapters, receipts, recovery, and evaluation
canonicals.commercial_role: Architecture canonical that connects tool discovery to FrankX agent-system expertise

wave_gates.gate: Publish exactly the atlas, ultimate guide, and Pallyy-versus-Metricool face-off after source, rights, content, accessibility, preview, and production verification.
Advance only when first-wave search and atlas behavior shows qualified interest, every target vendor record is refreshed, and each canonical owns a distinct intent.
Advance only with deeper enterprise or implementation evidence, no canonical collision, and a bounded production or workflow evaluation plan.

shared_measurement.program_hypothesis: A living role-based evidence atlas connected to distinct high-intent canonicals will earn search and answer-engine trust while moving qualified readers toward better tool and architecture decisions.
shared_measurement.primary_metric: Qualified organic entrances that select a role, compare tools, open official evidence, or continue between distinct program canonicals
guardrails: No more than three proof-wave canonicals
No documentation-backed claim presented as a production benchmark
No distribution without separate DISTRIBUTE authority
